name: Grom'gol Base Camp
summary: Grom'gol Base Camp holds the Horde's western coast position in Stranglethorn Vale. Commander Aggro'gosh leads the fortified outpost in northern Stranglethorn, with zeppelins linking the camp to Orgrimmar and the Undercity. Jungle trolls and hostile Alliance forces threaten the camp.

sections.title: A Bastion in the Jungle
sections.body: In northwestern Stranglethorn Vale, Commander Aggro'gosh holds Grom'gol Base Camp. Palisades and armed grunts guard against Bloodscalp headhunters, lurking naga, and prowling beasts. The camp keeps supply routes north to Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows open. Its sentries watch Alliance traffic coming down from Duskwood or up from Booty Bay.

sections.title: Airbridge of the Horde
sections.body: Wooden zeppelin towers make Grom'gol a key supply hub in the Eastern Kingdoms. Goblin skycraft fly regular routes from the camp to Orgrimmar and the Undercity. This airbridge brings Horde reinforcements and supplies straight into Stranglethorn, away from Alliance-held highways and the deep sea.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Grom'gol Base Camp?
faq.answer: Grom'gol Base Camp is the Horde's fortified staging point in Stranglethorn Vale. Commander Aggro'gosh leads it, and its supply route to Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows helps protect Horde interests from jungle trolls and Alliance incursions.

faq.q: How do you travel to and from Grom'gol?
faq.answer: Zeppelins from Grom'gol fly directly to Orgrimmar in Kalimdor and the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades. A wind rider roost connects the camp to Kargath, Stonard, and Booty Bay.
Commander Aggro'gosh, an orc, leads Grom'gol Base Camp. He oversees its defense against native troll tribes, wild raptors, and Alliance scouts.

faq.q: What threats does the camp face?
faq.answer: Grom'gol faces threats on every side. Bloodscalp jungle trolls hunt along its borders, raptors stalk the fields to the north, and Alliance soldiers travel down from Duskwood or up from Booty Bay.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can use Grom'gol as a safe haven and staging ground while crossing Stranglethorn Vale's jungles and contested roads.
As an Alliance traveler, you face a heavily defended Horde bastion at Grom'gol, with zeppelin routes reaching deep into the southern Eastern Kingdoms.
